name: kinetis/migrations
description: A thin database migration runner and migrate commands for Kinetis — raw SQL up()/down() migrations, no fluent DDL builder, no schema-diffing.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required by the migrate* commands when DB_CONNECTION=mysql; migrations always hold one PDO session, whatever DB_DRIVER says.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required by the migrate* commands when DB_CONNECTION=pgsql; migrations always hold one PDO session, whatever DB_DRIVER says.
